title: Why L1 and L2 Are Spacecraft Gold

segments.text: Why do spacecraft love the Sun‑Earth L1 and L2 spots?
At L1, the Sun’s pull, Earth’s pull, and centrifugal force cancel, giving an orbital period equal to Earth’s.
DSCOVR lives there, watching solar wind and imaging Earth’s sunlit side, providing real‑time space‑weather alerts.
At L2, the same three forces balance, allowing the James Webb and Roman telescopes to sit behind a sunshield that blocks Sun, Earth, and Moon light.
Both points need minimal fuel for station‑keeping and provide constant power and line‑of‑sight to Earth.
That is why L1 and L2 are prized locations for spacecraft.
